title: Friend Suggestion
summary: A social app's friend graph gives odd answers. Fix how friendships are stored, suggest people you may know and measure degrees apart, then serve a network of a hundred thousand users.
followUps: How did a one-character slip make the graph directed, and which test caught it first?
Why does breadth-first search give the shortest number of steps, and when would it not?
What is the cost of suggestions for a user with d friends who each have d friends?
The network has a celebrity with two million friends. What happens to suggestions for their friends, and what would you change?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
